title: Halting makes a choice suffix irrelevant
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $C$ a configuration on a fixed input, and $u,v$ finite Boolean words. If running from $C$ under the choice word $u$ reaches a halted configuration, then running from $C$ under the concatenated choice word $uv$ yields the same configuration as running under $u$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $C$ on a fixed input
